summary.content:
Today's selection covers 53 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 38 on Artificial Intelligence and 15 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Anthropic explains how Claude’s invisible text watermarks will work
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: 40,000 Impacted by SafePal Data Breach
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, SecurityWeek, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, Ars Technica and others
• **Fresh Content**: 21 articles published in the last 24 hours
